question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Chastise
solution:
The correct answer is **Discipline**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** synonym for the given word '**Chastise**' is '**Discipline**'.
 
• The word '**Chastise**' means '**to punish somebody physically**'.
 
• The word '**Discipline**' means **'train (someone) to obey rules or a code of behaviour, using punishment to correct disobedience'.**
 
• Hence, the appropriate answer is '**Discipline**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• **Order**- the way in which people or things are arranged in relation to each other.
 
• **Sever ties**- to end a connection with someone or something.
 
• **Chase**- to run after somebody/something in order to catch him/her/it.
